# Hosts a workspace may reach over HTTPS, one per line. A leading dot covers
# subdomains. Anything not here, or in the operator's list, is refused.
#
# These are the shipped defaults. Do not edit this file to add a host: add it
# to app/data/egress/allowlist.txt (same syntax, outside git), then run
#   docker compose exec squid squid -k reconfigure
# The app reads both files and refuses an LLM endpoint whose host is in
# neither, at save and at queue (app/backend/app/egress.py).
#
# LLM providers: every remote host the provider catalog names
# (providers.catalog_hosts(); a test keeps the two in step).
api.anthropic.com
api.openai.com
openrouter.ai
api.together.xyz
api.fireworks.ai
api.deepinfra.com
generativelanguage.googleapis.com
# Distributors (Stage 8's lifecycle audit, sourcing)
api.digikey.com
api.mouser.com
api.element14.com
wmsc.lcsc.com

github.com
codeload.github.com
